rules: Use all-flat single-colour icons from icons-flat for navigation and app actions.
Use icons-flat/nav_settings.svg for navigation; icons-flat/settings.svg for the application bar.
Preserve black and white inside masks: they control transparency.
For flat visible artwork, recolour non-white paint to the context foreground and visible white counters to the context background. Do not recolour mask operators.
Namespace every SVG id and matching url(#id) reference when combining multiple instances.
Redo is the Undo master mirrored horizontally about the 64-unit viewBox centre.
